name: Ling-mini-2.0
notes: top-2 of 8 experts but expert width 14,336: expert path is ~11.27B params/token, i.e. ~5.6 GB/token at 4-bit. Recorded as the bandwidth floor-of-shame reference point for expert streaming, not a candidate. KV basis: 20 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 40,960 B/token (40.0 KiB). head_dim 128 is explicit in config.json; uniform full attention. context_tokens is the config's native max_position_embeddings 32768 - the card's '32K -> 128K (YaRN)' claim needs rope_scaling factor 4, which the shipped config does not set (rope_scaling null), so 32,768 is the served window as shipped. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Record has no benchmark rows; card publishes no numeric benchmark table for this model.
